summary: Prudential plc furnished a 6-K containing its Hong Kong Exchange announcement under Listing Rule 17.06A disclosing a routine grant of 10,155 share options on 2 October 2026 to 14 eligible employees under the Prudential Sharesave Plan 2023, approved at the 25 May 2023 AGM. The exercise price is GBP 8.07 per share, roughly 88% of the GBP 9.18 closing price, with vesting over three or five years and exercise windows running December 2029 to May 2030 or December 2031 to May 2032. No director, CEO or substantial shareholder participated; no special-situation event is present, with remaining scheme mandate capacity of 192,014,621 shares the only notable structural datum.
